item.subject: science
item.stem:
Priya does a science project at home in Chennai. She takes a leaf from her potted tulsi plant, boils it in water, then in spirit to remove the green colour, and rinses it. She then adds a few drops of iodine solution to the leaf.
The leaf turns blue-black.
What does this result show?

options.A: The leaf contains starch, which the plant stored as food.
options.B: The leaf contains chlorophyll, which turns iodine blue-black.
options.C: The leaf contains no food, because the spirit removed it.
options.D: The leaf contains glucose, which gives a blue-black colour with iodine.
